MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The HDMI cable was the closest match because I have bought a display cable before, so connecting computer equipment is relevant to me.",
    "Even that cable was not something I would choose now: my earlier DVI purchase does not mean I currently need an HDMI connection."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo speakers and displays serve voice-assistant or video-calling needs that my computer accessories do not suggest I have.",
    "The Fire TV devices focus on television streaming, while my purchases have helped connect or expand computer equipment.",
    "Buying a headset does not mean I need a portable speaker; listening through a headset and playing sound aloud serve different purposes for me."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The recommendations seem to treat an interest in computer accessories as an interest in electronics generally.",
    "Several generations of Alexa and streaming devices repeat an assumption that I want home entertainment or voice-assistant products, without a purchase suggesting that need."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My Wi-Fi adapter, USB expansion card, and USB-to-Ethernet adapter point toward practical connection needs, where the specific ports and compatibility matter.",
    "My purchases are widely spaced, and I rarely interact unless something meets a concrete need; owning a related accessory does not establish that I need another one now."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized a broad interest in electronics but missed my occasional, specific need for practical computer accessories."
}
